confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Sri Lankan prices and the supplied city context. No live booking pages, menus or listings were checked. Trincomalee is a small coastal town with sparse price data, so all anchors are approximate. Alcohol prices are the least certain because of high Sri Lankan excise and because many local eateries do not serve alcohol. July falls in the east coast's peak season, so accommodation estimates lean toward the higher end. The FX value was taken from RBA exchange-rates page search snippets and was not opened directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: other mid-sized coastal and beach towns in Sri Lanka's northeast and east, such as Batticaloa and Arugam Bay, adjusted for Trincomalee's smaller tourist base and lower accommodation supply. Restaurant and café anchors reflect general Sri Lankan local-venue pricing, and accommodation reflects east-coast seasonal demand in July. Beer and cocktail anchors use the typical local relationship of cocktails at roughly 1.8 to 2 times the price of a bottled domestic beer, because direct knowledge of bar pricing in this town is weak.
